name: gas-flow-carry
description: Arithmetic: with no electric field, collisions drive the ion toward the frame the gas is at rest in, so its steady drift IS the gas velocity and the transit is L / u = 1.0 m / 200 m/s = 5000 us. No mobility, cross section or collision model enters. The ion is launched at exactly 200 m/s (0.103642697 V for m/z 500) so there is no equilibration lag either. Ten per cent, because a single ion drifting for five milliseconds also diffuses - and because the check is enormously discriminating anyway: a run that ignored the declared flow would damp the ion to rest and travel 15.8 mm in twenty milliseconds instead of arriving at all. The tolerance is RELATIVE, as every tolerance in this format is. It read 500 here, meant as plus or minus 500 us on 5000 - which as a fraction admitted any positive answer at all, so the example could not fail. Ten per cent is what the description always claimed, and the measured 4904.5 us sits 1.91% under the closed form.
